About This Hub

The NUNSA FUOYE Academic Hub was created by Precious Busola Adegboyega, 400-level nursing student and Vice President, NUNSA FUOYE Chapter, as part of a commitment to make academic resources freely accessible to every nursing student at FUOYE, organised by level, available 24/7, and built to grow with you.

Resources are uploaded by students, alumni, and the NUNSA Academic Team, reviewed before publishing, and updated regularly. If you have materials to contribute, use the Upload button above.

📅 Last Updated: July 2026
📚 Levels: 100 — 500
🎓 Alumni Mentors: Growing
✅ All resources reviewed before publishing

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I access a resource? +

Tap any resource card. It will open the linked Google Drive folder directly. All resources are free to view and download. No login required.

How do I upload a resource? +

Click the Upload Resource button, fill in the details and paste your Google Drive link. Your submission will be reviewed and published within 24 hours if approved.

Who can apply for alumni mentorship? +

The Alumni Mentorship Programme is open to 400 and 500-level FUOYE nursing students only. It focuses on professional exam preparation and clinical guidance.

How do I become an alumni mentor? +

If you are a FUOYE nursing graduate, reach out to adegboyegap246@gmail.com with the subject "Alumni Mentor Application." We will respond within 48 hours.

A resource I need is not here. What do I do? +

Use the Upload button to submit any materials you have, or email adegboyegap246@gmail.com with the course name and what you need.
